angularDiameterSource: Computed here from the record's radius and distance: 2 x 730,485 km at 166.80 pc = 0.06 mas. No interferometric diameter of this star is used.
distanceSource: Gaia DR3 parallax 5.9951 +/- 0.0154 mas (same row, RUWE 1.00): 166.80 pc, no zero-point correction
radiusSource: Radius 1.05 +/- 0.03 solar radii from Lockley et al. 2025, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of TOI-1117 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2025MNRAS.541..919L/abstract): 730,485 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. Mass 0.97 +/- 0.02 solar masses from Lockley et al. 2025, the stellar mass of the default parameter set of TOI-1117 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2025MNRAS.541..919L/abstract); GM is that mass times the JPL solar GM. Temperature 5635 +/- 62 K from Lockley et al. 2025, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of TOI-1117 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2025MNRAS.541..919L/abstract). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
effectiveTemperatureSource: Lockley et al. 2025, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of TOI-1117 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2025MNRAS.541..919L/abstract)
surfaceGravitySource: log g from the mass and radius in packages/astronomy/data/bodies/toi-1117.json (sources in its physicalNotes), log10(GM/R^2) in cgs: 4.382, rounded to two decimals
spectralTypeSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-1117 (pscomppars): spectral type G5 V, from Lockley et al. 2025 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2025MNRAS.541..919L/abstract)
objectTypeSource: SIMBAD, TOI-1117: main object type *, Star
metallicitySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-1117 (pscomppars): [Fe/H] 0.136 dex, from Lockley et al. 2025 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2025MNRAS.541..919L/abstract)
luminositySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-1117 (pscomppars): log10 of the luminosity in solar units -0.4437, from Lockley et al. 2025 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2025MNRAS.541..919L/abstract)
ageSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-1117 (pscomppars): age 4.42 Gyr, from Lockley et al. 2025 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2025MNRAS.541..919L/abstract)
rotationPeriodSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-1117 (pscomppars): rotation period 40 d, from Lockley et al. 2025 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2025MNRAS.541..919L/abstract)
projectedRotationSpeedSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-1117 (pscomppars): projected rotation speed 1.32 km/s, from Lockley et al. 2025 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2025MNRAS.541..919L/abstract)
spinInclinationSource: Computed here from this record's rotation period, projected rotation speed and radius (1.05 solar radii): sin i = v sin i × P / (2πR) = 0.994. Not a measurement of the axis: the three numbers come from different papers.

shape.qualification: A sphere at the published radius, colored from the star's Gaia DR3 BP/RP spectrum (photometry/stellar-color.json); no image of the photosphere exists.
